name: @sintaxerror/safereach
description: Model-neutral, consent-gated trusted human handoffs. Mock-only local MVP.

scripts.test: npm run build && node --test dist/test/*.test.js test/*.test.mjs desktop/*.test.mjs
scripts.poki: npm run build && npm run inbox
scripts.desktop:pack:mac: npm run build && node desktop/package.mjs darwin
scripts.desktop:pack:win: npm run build && node desktop/package.mjs win32
scripts.desktop:connected: npm run build && npm --prefix apps/connected run build && electron . --connected
scripts.desktop:pack:connected:mac: npm run build && npm --prefix apps/connected run build && node desktop/package.mjs darwin --connected
scripts.desktop:pack:connected:win: npm run build && npm --prefix apps/connected run build && node desktop/package.mjs win32 --connected
scripts.site:build: npm --prefix apps/connected run build && node scripts/publish-site.mjs
